_note: Builder B (charts-equations-net), 10 Oct 2026. Equations for the neural-net candy (fx/netviz.js) that research/rev2/equations.json may lack: the forward pass, the four backpropagation equations, the gradient-descent update and scaled dot-product attention. Schema guessed to match equations.json (that file did not exist yet when this was written): {equations: [{id, name, tex, source: {authors, title, year, where, eq, url}, verified: {how, date}, terms, notes}]}. fx/equations.js reads both files (EDL item field "ref": "<id>"). TeX is copied verbatim from the cited source (MathJax/LaTeX source), apart from removing the trailing full stop or comma that ends the sentence in the source; nothing was retyped from memory.
verification_method: Nielsen: downloaded http://neuralnetworksanddeeplearning.com/chap1.html and chap2.html (10 Oct 2026; the https endpoint serves a mismatched certificate, http was used) and extracted the MathJax TeX source of each tagged eqnarray with a regular expression; the strings below are those sources with the \tag removed. Vaswani: downloaded the arXiv LaTeX source https://arxiv.org/e-print/1706.03762v7 and copied equation (1) from model_architecture.tex line 41. Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams (1986) is the original backpropagation paper (Nature 323, 533-536); its notation differs (E, x_j, y_j, w_ji, Delta w = -epsilon dE/dw, its eqs. 4-8); the forms used here are Nielsen's matrix/Hadamard restatement, so every equation is cited to Nielsen, with RHW 1986 named as the origin in 'origin'.
